review.assessment: This change introduces solution.ts as a new file containing only the raw character-for-character reversal logic requested in the prompt to be fixed. It does not modify any existing file, nor does it implement case insensitivity or filtering for spaces and punctuation.

findings.call: node -e "import('./solution').then(m => console.log(m.isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')))"
findings.defect: The isPalindrome function fails to ignore spaces and punctuation. Raw string comparison 's === reversed' will always fail for inputs containing non-alphanumeric characters that do not form exact palindromes in their raw form.
